skills.description: Install and use the official SkillHub CLI to connect to skillhub.cn and publish local skills to the community source. Use when the user wants to (1) connect to SkillHub / set up publishing, (2) install the skillhub CLI, (3) log in with a personal API token (skh_...), (4) verify identity (whoami), or (5) publish/push a local skill directory or .zip. Includes the Windows Git Bash path-compatibility fix (cygpath) and python3 symlink workaround, plus the publish dry-run workflow.
skills.name: SkillHub 发布管道

skills.description:
Search MATLAS (Atlas of Mathematics), a semantic search engine for mathematical
theorems, definitions, lemmas, corollaries, and conclusions. This skill should be
used when the user asks to search for, look up, or retrieve mathematical content —
including theorem statements, formal definitions, known results, or references
from the mathematical literature. Triggers include phrases like "search matlas for X",
"look up theorem X on matlas", "find the definition of X in mathematical literature",
"search for mathematical results about X", or any request to use matlas.ai.
skills.name: atalas数学文献
